scope: Additive component contracts. Existing inventories remain unchanged; no full replacement assertion equivalence is claimed. TST-37 and family owners migrate consumers; TST-45 owns acceptance.

cases.assertion_purpose: Fresh immutable seed, copied local authority/index, real bytes and modes.
cases.negative_control: Mutate copied HEAD/index/config and another world's remote; original reads/files remain unchanged.

cases.assertion_purpose: Symbolic/unborn/detached HEAD, parent graph, tree/blob bytes.
cases.negative_control: Missing refs/objects/parents refuse; reverse ancestry and detached symbolic-ref fail.

cases.assertion_purpose: HEAD/index/worktree separation, mode/deletion/ignored/untracked state, NUL paths and unrelated index preservation.
cases.negative_control: Compare committed/staged/physical bytes independently; deleted blobs refuse; recreated paths retain separate untracked rows.

cases.assertion_purpose: Remote advertisement independent of local storage; explicit fetch recovery.
cases.negative_control: Advertised head exists while local cat-file fails; failed fetch leaves FETCH_HEAD absent until retry.

cases.assertion_purpose: New publication primitive contracts; family owners retain full delivery journeys.
cases.negative_control: Suppress stage/commit/fetch/push and detect absent mutations through later reads; race leases before command/effect; scheduled hook writes become dirty.

cases.assertion_purpose: Strict request/fault accounting and process prohibition.
cases.negative_control: Unsupported fields escape StandardError; omitted required faults fail; repeated faults consume separately; native fallback is denied before spawn.
Physical untracked file changes snapshot dirty flag; unavailable remote raises RepositoryError.

cases.assertion_purpose: Production inventory, pinned objects, writer/reader identity, admin pointers, collision and cleanup gates.
cases.negative_control: Tamper real backpointer; omit worktree effect; occupy/symlink roots; raw copies confer no authority; explicit fetch recovers missing storage.

cases.assertion_purpose: Real file/link/directory transitions, administration identity and nonregular metadata refusal.
cases.negative_control: Real FIFO survives production lstat refusal; replaced .git cannot borrow authority; writes through symlink ancestors fail.

cases.assertion_purpose: Continuous public CLI preparation/status/stale/refusal/reprepare/start with pinned-source validation and durable state.
cases.negative_control: Move remote; remove pinned commit/blob or corrupt source; remove remote ref. Refused starts preserve state; successful start writes started_at; no process added.
